name: Instruct-NeRF2NeRF
definition: A diffusion-based method for editing a NeRF scene guided by text instructions, utilizing InstructPix2Pix [9].
summary: Instruct-NeRF2NeRF edits 3D scenes via text by iteratively updating training images with 2D diffusion models, differing from methods using explicit 3D deformation fields.
